title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A Victorian inventor builds a machine that carries him hundreds of thousands of years into the future. There he finds a gentle, helpless people living above ground and something hungry below it.
readIf: you want the classic time-travel story, brief and still unsettling.
skipIf: you want elaborate paradoxes or deep characters, because the focus is on one idea and a single traveller.

pairings.reason: The author's other short classic, with the same eerie sense of humanity's smallness.
A very different, romantic and emotional use of time travel that is about love instead of a warning.
A modern thriller that plays with memory and time, with faster twists and a stronger emotional hook.
